body:
## Problem

`specApprovalIntegrityErrors` (packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs) validates that a recorded `spec-approval` manifest entry has a non-empty `approver` string, but does not verify any credential establishing that a human, rather than the working agent, produced the entry. `assertPhase` does not call `gate-manifest verify`/`verifyEntrySig` for any phase's evidence today (verified via `grep -n "verify\\|sig\\b" packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs packages/runner/bin/adlc.mjs` returning no matches as of T-01M05MKHZ64D55663AMMQXFSWZ). Any process holding `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` -- which is not currently distinct from the working agent's own access in this repository's key model -- can invoke the generic `gate-manifest record spec-approval` command with an arbitrary `approver` string and no human interaction, and pass the P1 gate.

## Context

This gap is deliberately documented, not fixed, in .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md's "Open question: `approver` identity is not cryptographically verified" section, which was shipped as part of T-01M05MH142KEXEY28HM4SRSDC8 (the P1 hard-gate ticket). Four options were left open there: (a) add HMAC signature verification as a partial mitigation (does not by itself distinguish a human from an agent holding the same key), (b) build a human-scoped signing capability distinct from the agent's key, (c) accept the harness-UI-pause convention (AskUserQuestion/confirm dialog before the CLI runs) as the system's existing human-gate model -- p6-acceptance-packet already relies on this same property -- or (d) block until resolved. This ticket exists to track that decision and its implementation; it does not itself pick an option.

## Acceptance criteria

- A decision is recorded (in this ticket's body, updated via `adlc ticket update`, or in a follow-on spec) choosing one of options (a)-(d) above, with the reasoning for that choice: verify with `adlc ticket show <this-id> --json | grep -q decision` after the ticket is updated with the chosen option, OR a new spec file exists at `.adlc/specs/*.md` referencing this ticket id.
- If (a) or (b) is chosen: `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`'s `specApprovalIntegrityErrors` rejects an unsigned or invalidly-signed `spec-approval` entry: verify with `node --test packages/runner/test/p0-p1-gates.test.mjs` after adding a test that records an unsigned entry and asserts `assertPhase('p1', ...)` returns `ok: false`.
- If (c) is chosen: the spec's "Open question" section is updated to state this as the accepted model rather than an open question, and a rationale is added explaining why UI-pause-before-CLI is sufficient given this system's threat model: verify with `grep -q 'Open question' .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md` returning no matches (the section header is retitled once resolved).
- If (d) is chosen: this ticket documents what blocks resolution and what unblocks it.
title: P1 spec-approval gate cannot distinguish a human approver from the working agent
